_note: Website settings. Slides: each entry may name an "image" file inside slides/ (leave out for the court-line background). Images in slides/ that no entry names are added as photo-only slides. match_time like "18:00" turns on the full countdown; leave empty while unknown. placements: final position of the team that loses each elimination match (the winner of the last one is 1st).

eggs._note: Flower board (ex rotten eggs; same Apps Script web app scripts/apps_script/eggs.gs over the Google Sheet 'MCGAAW Cup — Trứng thối'). Empty api_url = each viewer only counts on their own device. daily_limit 0 = unlimited. flower_base = each player's egg total when eggs became flowers (2026-11-05): the old eggs still count as flowers, bouquets (10 = 1) count only flowers given after it.
